raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "gsw-xarray" %}
{% set version = "0.5.0" %}
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name.replace('-', '_') }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 75bb503731514a2621e97152bae09cf43ab3716728554be55af183568933ef84

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - hatchling >=1.27
    - python {{ python_min }}
  run:
    - gsw >=3.6.20
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - xarray >=2023.09
    - cf_xarray >=0.8
  run_constrained:
    - pint-xarray >=0.6
    - Pint >=0.24.4

test:
  imports:
    - gsw_xarray
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/DocOtak/gsw-xarray
  summary: Drop in wrapper for gsw which adds CF standard name and units attributes to xarray results
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.rst
  dev_url: https://gsw-xarray.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rcaneill
    - DocOtak
